svg.text: Goal: Track the sequence of reliability qualification milestones for an optical module before release.

g.text: Confirm stress plan, sample size, and pass criteria
Release screened samples and golden units
Approve aging, thermal cycling, damp heat, and ESD scope
Start long-duration high-temperature operating life test
Check power drift, BER trend, and temperature margin
Decide whether observed failures require corrective action
Approve production release with documented residual risks
